test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

By next December / we will has lived / in this city for 28 years.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is referring to an action in the future** ("By next December")** and using the future perfect tense ("we will have lived") with a time period ("for 28 years").
 
• The phrase "we will has lived" is incorrect because "has" should be replaced with "have" to form the correct future perfect tense ("will have lived").

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"By next December, we will have lived in this city for 28 years."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "in this city for 28 years"** – This part is correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• **Option 3: "by next December"** – This part is correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• **Option 4: "we will has lived"** – This part contains the error. "Has" should be replaced with "have" to form the correct future perfect tense.
